prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1177; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or any other means. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any excess or umbrella coverage, along with a declarations page for each policy. Please also confirm whether coverage is being disputed in any respect.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Destruction or alteration of such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
